Body.Content:
Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience.

This integration also brings Maker Studio generative page authoring to regions without dedicated Power Apps GPU capacity.

Model availability through GitHub may evolve over time, and requests made through this connection consume the maker’s GitHub credits.
